name: comic-sans
author: Eduardo Minholi, Nuno Abilio
description: A fan-made survival challenge inspired by an iconic final battle: guide the SOUL through waves of bones and Flappy Bone walls. Arrows to move.

descriptions.en: A fan-made survival challenge inspired by an iconic final battle: guide the SOUL through waves of bones and Flappy Bone walls. Arrows to move.
descriptions.it: Una sfida di sopravvivenza fan-made ispirata a una celebre battaglia finale: guida l'anima tra raffiche di ossa e muri Flappy Bone. Frecce per muoverti.
